execution.terminal_signal: exit_code from the preserved process session

arm_capability_contract.unlisted_capability: Violated; invalid arm and hard stop

order.timestamps: optional exact copy or Unknown; never used for precedence

normalized_event_contract.canonical_json_algorithm: UTF-8 RFC8259, recursively lexicographically sorted object keys, arrays preserved, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped Unicode

response_hashes.web: sha256(canonical explicit raw response payload) when present; otherwise Unknown

required: search has non-empty action.query or action.queries entry
web_event_contract.status: Copy exact item.status; null or absent remains Unknown.
web_event_contract.locator: Use action.url or direct final-output evidence_references locator; never synthesize.
web_event_contract.missing_identity_or_action: Unknown transport observability, arm invalid for pair completion, hard stop without replacement.
web_event_contract.missing_response_payload: response_sha256 Unknown; no invented body or hash.

treatment_precedence.bateia_finish_sequence: finish_sequence of the sole completed bateia_recommend lifecycle
treatment_precedence.first_web_observable_sequence: minimum web start_sequence when present, otherwise finish_sequence
treatment_precedence.unknown_or_false: Treatment arm cannot complete the pair.

postconditions.treatment_bateia_count: exactly 1 distinct completed normalized bateia_recommend event_id
postconditions.pair_success: Exactly two valid arms under all frozen bindings and exactly one valid pair.

evaluation_contract.blind_output_phase: Freeze a comparison receipt over opaque labels before revealing arms, traces, costs or call counts.
evaluation_contract.post_reveal_phase: Audit catalysis only after blind receipt freeze using normalized sequence and resolvable evidence.
evaluation_contract.catalytic_path: Bateia direction -> strictly later native web event -> useful supported confirmation, rejection or narrowing reflected in final output.
evaluation_contract.inconclusive: Neutral abstention; neither automatic success nor defeat.
evaluation_contract.treatment_uplift: Blind preference for revealed treatment plus at least one proven catalytic path.
evaluation_contract.live_web_temporal_drift: Unknown confounding unless resolved, never automatic equality.

classification.Unknown: Required identity, ordering, trace linkage, temporal comparability, parseability or support is not observable.
classification.unknown_default: No implicit success, failure, tie, zero, loss or retry.
